subject.title: Control UI display bugs after 2026.7.2-beta.3 + font size customization request

question: Should the typography portion become a separate Control UI proposal for a fixed visual hierarchy or for a persisted user font-size preference?
rationale: The regression symptoms have an established expected behavior, but a new configurable typography surface is a product and settings-contract decision rather than a necessary consequence of the bug fix.

options.title: Split and triage the regression
options.body: Keep this issue focused on reproducible display failures and open or link a separate typography proposal after deciding whether configuration is justified.

options.title: Improve fixed hierarchy only
options.body: Increase section-header distinction through the design system without adding a persisted user preference.

options.title: Sponsor a user preference
options.body: Define a supported, persisted dashboard font-scale setting with accessibility and upgrade behavior before implementation.

recommendation.title: Split and triage the regression
recommendation.body: Keep this issue focused on reproducible display failures and open or link a separate typography proposal after deciding whether configuration is justified.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI contribution history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the dashboard typography and projection decision.
